decisions.reason: As a product only briefly mentioned in 2019 and less clearly embedded in the firm's apparent lifting niche, it is likely to have fallen short of aspiration levels and to be a candidate for resource reallocation.

Its dedicated product-page launch and close fit with a specialised material-handling portfolio suggest results may be near aspiration levels, so boundedly rational management would likely retain it while uncertainty remains.

This product appears to match the firm's probable core capabilities best, and with no clear evidence of failure the firm would likely use available slack to continue it rather than abandon it prematurely.

Although this variant may be more resource-intensive and faces some risk if sales lag aspirations, its dedicated launch and complementarities with the lift line make continued retention slightly more likely than withdrawal.
